author: Inside Edition
description: It has been revealed that the Nancy Guthrie ransom note was addressed directly to Savannah Guthrie. CBS News also revealed that the kidnapper's note goes on to describe the "exact location of Nancy's Apple Watch inside her bedroom," a detail that had never been made public and was meant to show the ransom demand was the real deal. The $4 million ransom was never paid and investigative reporter and bestselling author Howard Blum says detectives he spoke to are regretting that decision.
title: Nancy Guthrie's Ransom Note Was Addressed Directly To Savannah Guthrie

author: Inside Edition
description: A 17-year-old was paddleboarding with her uncle enjoying the water and beautiful weather. What she did not know was there was a great white shark just a few feet away. The scary showdown happened off the coast of Santa Barbara. Kayla Ross, the teen on the paddleboard, spoke with Inside Edition. She says she and her uncle went out looking for sharks but he did not realize one was so close by.
title: Great White Shark Stalks Teen And Her Uncle On Paddleboard

author: Inside Edition
description: With no time to waste, a Toledo Police officer saved a woman from her burning home. The officer moved items around the home to make a path, then battled the smoke, intense heat, and zero visibility to get to the disabled resident. After convincing the woman to leave the walker behind, he gets her out safely. But as they exit, he realizes his job isn't done. Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall has more.
title: Toledo Police Officer Rescues Disabled Woman From Burning Home

author: Inside Edition
description: A playground in Copenhagen is not only getting kids away from screens, it's also encouraging parents to do the same. The new space is a screen-free zone, with signs reminding adults to disconnect from technology and be present with their children, even during playtime. The company that created the playground says screens are a source of conflict for families and cause dissatisfaction among kids. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Screen-Free Playground Encourages Parents To Disconnect From Tech
